#
#   Reads in the Q-values from multiple outputs from STRUCTURE runs 
#   and summarizes. 
#
# example use: https://www.royfrancis.com/pophelper/reference/readQ.html       

```{r}
library(pophelper)

# PURES
exp_output_folder <- "/work/williarj/williarj/2627_HJH_Thesis/experiments/10_23_26_k2_k3_pures_dataset"
str_results_folder <- "/work/williarj/williarj/2627_HJH_Thesis/experiments/10_23_26_k2_k3_pures_dataset"
original_structure_input_file <- "/work/williarj/williarj/2627_HJH_Thesis/data/raw_input/Ebrahimi_3_3_2026_prepared/renamed_pure_jc_ja.str"

# WILD HYBRIDS
exp_output_folder <- "/work/williarj/williarj/2627_HJH_Thesis/experiments/10_26_26_k2_k3_hybrids_dataset"
str_results_folder <- "/work/williarj/williarj/2627_HJH_Thesis/experiments/10_26_26_k2_k3_hybrids_dataset"
original_structure_input_file <-"/work/williarj/williarj/2627_HJH_Thesis/data/raw_input/Ebrahimi_5_20_2026_prepared/prepared_with_hybrids.str"

figure_output_path <- "/work/williarj/williarj/2627_HJH_Thesis/scripts/r_analysis/Figures"
figure_name <- "with_wild_hybrids"

# Working directory is the folder running the script from:
print(getwd())

# Get the run files
sfiles <- list.files(str_results_folder, full.names = TRUE)
run_files <- sfiles[grepl("_f$", basename(sfiles))] # get only run files
print(run_files)
```

# K=2
```{r}
# Read the runs and automatically extract the individual labels
q_list <- readQ(files = run_files[1], filetype="structure", indlabfromfile = TRUE)
slist <- as.qlist(q_list)                                        
slist <- alignK(slist)  

# Summarize basic information in the structure files
table <- tabulateQ(slist, sorttable = TRUE, writetable = FALSE, exportpath = NULL)
summary <- summariseQ(table)
print(summary)

number_of_runs=length(slist)

# Reference for plots:https://www.royfrancis.com/pophelper/reference/plotQ.html#examples 
plotQ(
  qlist = slist[1],
  sortind = "all",
  sharedindlab = FALSE,
  exportpath = figure_output_path, 
  outputfilename = paste0("k2_",figure_name),
  
  # --- Add these arguments to show individual names ---
  showindlab = TRUE,       # Enables display of individual labels
  useindlab = TRUE,        # Uses labels from the dataframe rownames (extracted from file)
  width = 30,              # Expands width so names have room (adjust based on sample size)
  basesize = 3            # Increases font size slightly for readability
)
```
